# Hacker News fixtures

Synthetic, hand-written documents shaped like the official Firebase API
(<https://github.com/HackerNews/API>). They are **not** copies of real HN items; titles, users and
URLs are fictional (`example.org`). Coverage: normal story, Ask HN with HTML entities and encoded
markup, job, dead story, deleted story, comment, story with a non-web URL scheme, story without a
title (malformed), a `null` item, and a story present only in `newstories`/`beststories`.
